# ScreenshotManager

> **File:** `services/apps/ScreenshotManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Screenshots (the `screenshot` keybind action, IPC `screenshot take <kind>`, launcher `/screenshot`, the Screenshot card), taken natively: while `picking`, shell/Screenshot shows a frozen frame (ScreencopyView, or grim's picture where Quickshell can't capture safely: `grimFrames`) on each screen, where a region is dragged or a window clicked (`region`), or a window clicked (`window`), and crops it at the screen's own resolution. `screen` captures the focused monitor at once. The picture is saved in `folder` (the Screenshots section), or only to a scratch file with `copyOnly`, copied to the clipboard (ClipboardManager.copyFile: Quickshell's clipboard is text only) and either notified (click opens it) or opened in an annotator (satty or swappy; its notification also has an "Edit in …" button). Recording (IPC `screenRecord`, the `screenRecord` bind, launcher `/record`, or R / the Record switch in an open picker) picks its area in the same picker (kind `record`), or takes the focused screen at once (`mode: "screen"`, the ScreenRecord card), and runs wf-recorder on it until stopped, with the system's sound (through pactl: `hasSystemAudio`) or the microphone if asked (`audio`), into `recordingFolder`, whose newest recordings `recordings` lists for the ScreenRecord cards.

### Properties

- `picking` (bool): The picker is open (or an immediate capture is running)
- `busy` (readonly bool): Picking, or waiting for the launcher to close first (or for grim)
- `request` (var): { kind, screen: the screen an immediate `screen` capture takes }
- `copyOnly` (bool): Keep nothing on disk, only copy (saved in Paths.statePath screenshot.json)
- `recordAudio` (string): The sound the ScreenRecord card records with: "none" | "system" | "mic" (saved with copyOnly)
- `annotate` (bool): Open the next capture in the annotator (set in the picker)
- `annotator` (readonly string): "satty" | "swappy" | "": what annotating opens
- `annotatorName` (readonly string): Its name as shown ("Satty")
- `hasRecorder` (readonly bool)
- `hasSystemAudio` (readonly var): Whether the system's sound can be recorded: pactl finds the default output's monitor.
- `recording` (bool)
- `recordingSince` (real): When the running recording started (ms), 0 when unknown (started before a reload)
- `recordingElapsed` (int): Seconds recorded so far, ticking only while recording
- `recordings` (readonly var): The newest recordings in recordingFolder ([{ path, name, time, size }], newest first), once refreshRecordings has listed it
- `folder` (readonly string): Where screenshots are saved: the Screenshots setting, else <Pictures>/Screenshots
- `recordingFolder` (readonly string): Where recordings are saved and listed from: the setting, else with the screenshots
- `grimFrames` (readonly bool): The picker's frozen frames are grim's pictures, taken just before it opens, not Quickshell's own capture (ScreencopyView): where the compositor has no capture Quickshell does safely (CompositorManage…
- `frames` (readonly var): { screen name: picture path } while picking with grimFrames
- `kinds` (readonly var): The kinds take() offers: "window" only where the compositor knows where windows are (CompositorManager.supports.windowGeometry)
- `forCaller` (readonly bool)

### Functions

- `take(kind)`: kind: "region" | "window" | "screen" ("window" is "region" where it isn't in `kinds`)
- `pick(path, callback)`: A region for another feature (the chat): saved to `path` as a PNG, with no clipboard or notification, then callback(ok).
- `cancel()`
- `setCopyOnly(value)`
- `setRecordAudio(value)`
- `finish(result)`: Called by the picker with the cropped capture (a grabToImage result), or null when grabbing failed
- `edit(path)`: Opens a picture in the annotator, which saves over it
- `setRecordMode(on)`: Switches an open picker between taking a screenshot and recording
- `fail(reason)`
- `startRecording(options)`: Recording: an area picked in the picker (kind `record`), recorded by wf-recorder until stopRecording().
- `stopRecording()`: Ours gets SIGINT (wf-recorder finishes the file on it).
- `toggleRecording()`
- `record(area, screenName)`: Called by the picker with the area to record: global logical pixels, or a whole screen by name
- `frameArrived()`: Called by a picker when its frame is in.
- `refreshRecordings()`: Lists the newest recordings in recordingFolder into `recordings`
- `deleteRecording(path)`: Moves a recording to the trash, then lists the folder again
